scope: Final offline browser presentation acceptance only; not live product acceptance or a source, mathematical, semantic, or answer review.

actualChoiceCounts.basis: Counted emitted data-question attributes and radio/checkbox input tags in the saved choices.html; the passed browser checker also asserts each question's option count and exercises its controls.

layout.observation: Desktop content is centered and ordered; mobile prose and choice stems wrap within the column. No visible text/control overlap or page-wide horizontal overflow. Passed result records client/scroll widths of 1425/1425 desktop and 375/375 mobile.

formulasAndReadability.observation: Visible formulas, fractions, radicals, and subscripts occupy their own text flow without apparent collisions. The checker reports no KaTeX errors or browser console/page errors and enforces each figure's rendered label minimum.

navigationAndEndReachability.observation: Text screenshots reach the final proof and exercise link; exercise screenshots reach exercise 323 and the return link; choices reach question 15 and its complete option region. The checker clicks the text/exercise jump links in both viewports and asserts the destination.

figureWidths.observation: Desktop fig-125, fig-126, and fig-127 are visibly rendered with separated labels. Mobile screenshots show their right-edge scroll state, not a missing left portion of the asset: the checker deliberately scrolls every figure to its end before capture, asserts end reachability, checks scroll-layout SVG width equals 640 px, and checks scaled label sizes against the respective FigureSpec minimum.

options.observation: All 15 numbered choice blocks are present through the end in both screenshots. Radio/checkbox controls remain separate from option text and formulas. The checker exercises each question's first two controls, verifies single/multiple selection behavior, and checks for internal-field leaks. Saved HTML contains exactly 62 option inputs.

screenshots.observation: Both figures are complete within the centered column; proof text, formulas, captions, and final exercise navigation remain separate.
Prose and proof wrap cleanly and reach the final link. Large readable figure labels remain visible at the intentionally captured right scroll endpoint.
Exercises 310 through 323, worked formulas, complete fig-127, and the return link are visibly ordered without overlap.
Exercise numbering and wrapped worked solution remain separated; fig-127 is shown at its verified right scroll endpoint. Exercise 323 and return navigation are reachable at the end.
All 15 blocks and their option regions are visible in order. Fractions and radicals have vertical clearance; selection controls do not overlap option labels.
The title wraps without collision; stems and option regions remain ordered in the narrow column through question 15. No apparent cross-block overlap or page-wide clipping.

limitations: The image tool downscaled long full-page previews, especially mobile choices; fine-detail readability claims are supported by the passed browser's native rendered-label and overflow assertions, not by enlarging or reopening screenshots.
This is the supplied offline renderer and choice projection, not acceptance of the live product.
